metadata.description: Nestled along the Housatonic River on the coast of Long Island Sound sits Mill River Country Club the home of golf and social camaraderie for more than 85 years. Mill River Country Club boasts a long lineage of proud members and is a pillar of the community. With its location along the coastline we are convenient to the railroad that runs from New York to Boston.The Country Club itself is situated on 95 acres of land set in a scenic landscape of woods, streams, and meadows. The Club House includes, the Golf Pro Shop, three dining rooms, a grand ball room, a grill style bar room and locker facilities, a large bowling center with billiards, darts and six bowling lanes. Outside the Club House we have an Olympic size pool with snack bar and activities.

metadata.description:
Connecticut’s Hidden Jewel. Situated in the heart of Fairfield County, Richter Park encompasses over 180 acres of gentle rolling terrain. With West Lake Reservoir bordering seven holes on the front and Boggs Pond bordering the signature 12th, water can come into play on 14 out of 18 holes. Four sets of tees make this scenic layout accom modating for golfers of all skill levels and undulating fairways and fast rolling greens guarded by one of 52 bunkers surrounding the course make it a challenge at every turn.

Opened in 1972, this Edward Ryder designed course is well matured and bordered by large trees that make for a special treat in the fall with all the color against the backdrop
